title: Weight-Loss Drugs Change How People Drink in British Pubs
subtitle: As popularity for new medications grows, companies look at how consumer habits are shifting in the hospitality industry.

summary.en: New weight-loss drugs are becoming very popular among consumers. These medications, known as GLP-1 drugs, help people lose weight by changing their appetite. Heineken has warned that these drugs might lead to fewer beer sales in pubs. Some research suggests that users are choosing to drink less alcohol or picking lower-alcohol options. Other drink companies remain more confident that their business will stay strong.
summary.zh: 新型減重藥物在消費者中變得非常熱門。這些被稱為 GLP-1 的藥物透過改變食慾來幫助人們減重。海尼根警告，這些藥物可能會導致酒吧的啤酒銷量減少。部分研究顯示，使用者正選擇減少飲酒或挑選低酒精濃度的選項。其他飲料公司則對其業務保持強勁信心。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, a new type of medicine has changed the lives of millions of people. These drugs, known as GLP-1 medications, are designed to help people lose weight. According to The Guardian Health, the use of these drugs has grown very quickly, with 10 million people in the United States using them last year. While these medicines are helping people reach their health goals, they are also starting to change how people spend their money and time in social settings like pubs and bars.
paragraphs.zh: 近年來，一種新型藥物改變了數百萬人的生活。這些被稱為「GLP-1」的藥物旨在幫助人們減重。根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，這類藥物的使用量成長迅速，去年在美國就有 1,000 萬人使用。雖然這些藥物正幫助人們達成健康目標，但它們也開始改變人們在酒吧等社交場所花費金錢與時間的方式。

paragraphs.en: Heineken, one of the world’s largest beer companies, recently shared a presentation with British pubs and bars to talk about these changes. The company warned that the growing use of GLP-1 drugs could lead to a drop in the sales of beer and cider. The main reason for this change is that these drugs often make people feel full, which reduces their desire to drink alcohol. As a result, the traditional habit of sitting in a pub for several hours and drinking multiple pints of beer may become less common.
paragraphs.zh: 全球最大的啤酒公司之一海尼根（Heineken）最近向英國的酒吧與餐館分享了一份簡報，討論這些變化。該公司警告，GLP-1 藥物的使用增加，可能會導致啤酒與蘋果酒的銷量下滑。造成此轉變的主要原因是，這些藥物常讓人產生飽足感，進而降低飲酒的慾望。因此，在酒吧坐上幾個小時並連喝好幾杯啤酒的傳統習慣，可能會變得不再那麼普遍。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, Heineken suggests that pubs should change how they do business to keep customers coming back. The company recommended that bars promote smaller portions, such as half-pints, and offer more drinks that have little or no alcohol. They also suggested pairing drinks with small plates of food. A spokesperson for Heineken explained that they are watching these trends closely as they look toward 2027. The company noted that while some people are drinking less, others are simply becoming more careful about what they choose to drink, often picking higher-quality products or healthier options.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康》報導，海尼根建議酒吧應調整經營模式，以維持顧客的回流率。該公司建議酒吧推廣較小份量的飲品，例如半品脫啤酒，並提供更多低酒精或無酒精的選擇。他們也建議將飲品與小份餐點搭配銷售。海尼根的發言人解釋，他們正密切關注這些趨勢，並展望 2027 年的發展。該公司指出，雖然有些人飲酒量減少，但其他人只是對飲酒選擇變得更加謹慎，通常會挑選品質更高或更健康的產品。

paragraphs.en: Not everyone in the drink industry feels the same way about these changes. While some research companies, including Circana, NIQ, and KAM, have found evidence that people using these drugs are drinking less, other big companies have a different view. For example, the company that makes Guinness, Diageo, told its investors that it believes any impact from these weight-loss drugs will be small and easy to manage. Meanwhile, the brewer Carlsberg stated that current data does not support the idea that weight-loss drugs are significantly changing beer consumption trends.
paragraphs.zh: 飲料產業中並非每個人都對這些變化有相同的看法。雖然包括 Circana、NIQ 與 KAM 在內的一些研究公司已發現證據顯示，使用這些藥物的人飲酒量確實減少，但其他大型企業則有不同觀點。例如，生產健力士（Guinness）的帝亞吉歐（Diageo）公司告訴投資人，他們認為減重藥物帶來的任何影響都將是微小且容易應對的。同時，釀酒商嘉士伯（Carlsberg）則表示，目前的數據並不支持減重藥物正在顯著改變啤酒消費趨勢的說法。

paragraphs.en: This situation highlights a larger shift in how people think about their health and wellbeing. Heineken noted that the changes they see in GLP-1 users are not just about the medication itself. Instead, these habits are part of a wider trend where consumers are choosing to be more careful and intentional with their health. People are increasingly interested in moderation—the act of not having too much of something—and are looking for more variety in what they consume.
paragraphs.zh: 這種情況凸顯了人們在看待自身健康與福祉方面出現了更廣泛的轉變。海尼根指出，他們在 GLP-1 使用者身上觀察到的變化，不僅僅與藥物本身有關。相反地，這些習慣反映了一種更廣泛的趨勢，即消費者選擇對自己的健康採取更謹慎且有意識的態度。人們對「適度」——即不過度攝取某種東西——的興趣日益濃厚，並尋求更多樣化的消費選擇。

paragraphs.en: For the British hospitality industry, which relies heavily on beer sales, these trends are important to understand. According to The Guardian Health, the total sales of beer in British pubs, bars, and restaurants reached almost £14 billion in the year leading up to February. However, only a small part of that money came from low-alcohol or zero-alcohol products. As more people use weight-loss drugs, pubs may need to adapt their menus and marketing strategies to match the changing habits of their customers. Whether this will lead to a permanent change in pub culture or just a small shift in what people order remains to be seen as the market continues to evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 對於高度依賴啤酒銷售的英國餐飲業來說，理解這些趨勢至關重要。根據《衛報健康》報導，截至二月為止的一年間，英國酒吧、餐館與餐廳的啤酒總銷售額達到近 140 億英鎊。然而，其中僅有一小部分來自低酒精或無酒精產品。隨著越來越多人使用減重藥物，酒吧可能需要調整其菜單與行銷策略，以符合顧客不斷變化的習慣。這是否會導致酒吧文化發生永久性的改變，還是僅僅是點餐習慣上的微小轉變，仍有待市場持續演變後才能見分曉。

sources.title: Boom in weight-loss drugs could lead to fall in beer sales, Heineken warns UK pubs

quiz.question: What specific strategy does Heineken recommend to pubs to help them adjust to the impact of GLP-1 medications?

options.A: Reducing the total number of hours the pub remains open.
options.B: Promoting smaller drink servings and offering more non-alcoholic options.
options.C: Increasing the prices of all alcoholic beverages to maintain profit margins.
options.D: Replacing all high-calorie beer options with food-based menu items.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，Heineken 建議酒吧業者調整經營策略，具體包括推廣較小份量的飲料（如半品脫）以及提供更多無酒精或低酒精飲料。選項 A 文章未提及縮短營業時間；選項 C 文章未提到漲價策略；選項 D 雖然提到搭配小份食物，但並非要求「取代」所有高卡路里啤酒，故錯誤。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the current disagreement within the beverage industry regarding GLP-1 drugs?

options.A: All major brewing companies have officially stopped selling beer to GLP-1 users.
options.B: There is a consensus that GLP-1 drugs will soon cause the total collapse of the pub industry.
options.C: While some data suggests a decline in consumption, some industry leaders remain skeptical about the long-term impact.
options.D: Research companies like Circana and NIQ are the only ones predicting a rise in alcohol sales.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，Heineken 與部分研究機構發現飲酒量下降，但 Diageo 和 Carlsberg 等公司對此持保留態度，認為影響有限或數據不足以證明有顯著改變。選項 A 錯誤，沒有公司停止銷售；選項 B 過於誇大，文章並未預測產業崩潰；選項 D 錯誤，研究機構的發現與此相反，且並非唯一預測者。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the author mean by the word 'moderation'?

options.A: The act of avoiding something completely.
options.B: The practice of consuming things in reasonable, limited amounts.
options.C: The process of changing one's personality through medication.
options.D: The preference for expensive, high-quality products.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文中提到 moderation 是指「not having too much of something」，即適度、節制。選項 A 錯誤，完全避免（abstinence）與適度不同；選項 C 與藥物作用無關；選項 D 雖然文中提到人們開始追求高品質產品，但這與 moderation 的定義無直接關聯。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article?

options.A: GLP-1 medications are primarily dangerous substances that should be banned from pubs.
options.B: The rise of weight-loss drugs is forcing the hospitality industry to reconsider consumer habits and business strategies.
options.C: Heineken is the only company successfully adapting to the health trends of the 21st century.
options.D: British pubs are making more money than ever before because of new health-conscious customers.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。全文核心在於探討 GLP-1 藥物如何影響消費者的飲酒習慣，進而迫使餐飲業（特別是酒吧）必須思考如何調整經營模式以適應這股健康意識的潮流。選項 A 錯誤，文章未提及藥物危險；選項 C 錯誤，文中提到其他公司也有不同看法；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未指出酒吧獲利增加，反而是在討論銷售面臨的挑戰。
